concepts.proposed_markdown: In the 2026-08-28 List snapshot, optional top-level `Invoice.billable_status` is described as indicating whether the invoice has been or will be sent to the configured customer billing provider and defaults to `billable`. The same property combines a `$ref` to `BillableStatus` with sibling `type: object`, leaving its referenced-versus-object shape unresolved on this page. Keep this List-level delivery-intent field separate from nested `Invoice.external_invoice.external_status`; neither establishes external acceptance, customer delivery, payment, settlement, tax, accounting, or reconciliation. [[source-metronome-api-reference-invoices-list-invoices]]
warnings: Preserve the string-reference versus object-type schema conflict instead of selecting one shape.
Do not generalize List response observation into a billing-provider outcome guarantee or substitute the Get schema.

concepts.proposed_markdown: The 2026-08-28 invoice List schema adds optional, feature-annotated `access_type` under `AppliedCommitOrCredit`. It says `SPEND` deducts the dollar cost of usage and `QUANTITY` deducts the number of units used; unlike separate access-schedule mutation schemas, this response component states no default. Returned attribution does not establish access-schedule configuration, balance or ledger mutation, denomination, precision, rounding, or mutation acceptance. [[source-metronome-api-reference-invoices-list-invoices]]
warnings: Keep the response field under AppliedCommitOrCredit and do not move it to the top-level Invoice or InvoiceLineItem schema.
Do not inherit a SPEND default from separate create or edit operations into this List response.
